title: pharmacoepi_rw2synth
summary: A small collection of Python scripts for transforming real-world pharmacoepidemiology data into synthetic data and assessing re-identification/disclosure risk, using Synthpop and CT-GAN for data generation. The generate_synthetic_ctgan.py script imports SDV's single-table module and instantiates CTGANSynthesizer with a Metadata object to train and generate synthetic health records.
evidence: Epidemiol Prev/generate_synthetic_ctgan.py:17-46 imports CTGANSynthesizer, Metadata and instantiates synthesizer = CTGANSynthesizer(metadata, ...)
